rapport_notes: Friendly and efficient with a returning customer; quickly acknowledged her history with the company and matched her energy ('I love the morning so... yeah, that's good').

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'before I kind of dive too deep do you have any, just top of mind, concerns or questions that I can just answer right out the gate for you?' — asked immediately.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer said 'not really' and just noted she's a repeat customer familiar with the process; no concern to dig into.

top_strength: Efficiently and warmly re-engaged a repeat customer, correctly covering both damage coverage and Meet Your Mover as part of the takeaway, and delivered a clean, fully-inclusive quote that led to an easy same-call booking for a morning slot.
coaching_note: Communication (day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates) was the one differentiator never mentioned anywhere in the call — with everything else nailed, this is a simple line to add before the close to pick up the other half of the Stage 2 credit.
